QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_CT_ASM` (`constant_time_impl.h:42`) is defined only when `MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM` is on and the compiler is GCC-compatible or ARMCC (`__GNUC__` / `__ARMCC_VERSION`, lines 40–52).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says MBEDTLS_CT_ASM is defined in the header from MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM plus compiler predefined macros, which conveys that it is derived. It never says outright that it is not a config entry, but that follows from where it is defined.
